recurring.title: Recurring
recurring.subtitle: Repeating income and expenses are recorded automatically.

recurring.invalidAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
recurring.emptyBody: Add salary, rent, subscriptions and fixed bills to record them automatically.

recurring.deleteHint: Transactions already recorded stay in your history.
recurring.archivedSource: This account or card is archived. Choose another one.

groups.title: Groups
groups.subtitle: Add up spending with the people you live, travel or split bills with. Everyone still sees only their own details.
groups.name: Group name
groups.currencyHint: Only entries in this currency can go to the group. It can't be changed later.
groups.emptyBody: Create a group or join through an invite to add up spending with other people.
groups.entriesHint: To show an expense here, pick this group when you add it.
groups.inviteBody: Anyone who opens this link joins the group. It's valid for 7 days and can be used by several people.
groups.revokeConfirm: Revoke this link? Anyone who hasn't joined yet won't be able to use it.
groups.noActiveInvite: No active link. Create a new one to invite people.
groups.deleteConfirm: Delete the group? Entries stay with each person; they just stop being part of the group.
groups.leaveConfirm: Leave the group? Entries you already marked stay in the group's history.
groups.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the group? Entries already made stay in the history.
groups.makeAdminConfirm: Hand over admin to {{name}}? You stay in the group as a member.
groups.adminMustTransfer: To leave, hand over admin to another member or delete the group.
groups.notAdmin: Only the admin can do this.
groups.notMember: You're not part of this group.
groups.groupCurrency: This entry's currency is different from the group's currency.
groups.groupCurrencyHint: Only groups in {{currency}} accept this entry.
groups.privacyNote: The group only sees the entries you mark for it — never your accounts, cards or other spending.

join.title: Group invite
join.invalid: This invite doesn't exist. Ask whoever invited you for a new link.
join.expired: This invite expired or was revoked. Ask whoever invited you for a new link.
join.already: You're already part of this group.
join.full: This group already has the maximum of 50 members.
join.removed: You were removed from this group. To come back, ask the admin for a new link.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.subtitle: Set how much you want to spend per category each month. We'll warn you at 80% and 100%.
budgets.deleteConfirm: Delete this budget? Your entries don't change.
budgets.invalidAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.

budgets.duplicate: This category already has a budget in this currency.
budgets.systemOnly: In a group, only default categories can have a budget.
budgets.groupEmptyAdmin: Set monthly limits per category for the whole group.
budgets.groupHint: Adds up group entries from every member.
